agents.label: types-cation
agents.task: Types: sn1-products (4 worked, 12 practice; kinds mcq with structure choices and written: the substitution and elimination products of SN1/E1 conditions, racemization, the three-step mechanism with water or an alcohol, which substrates ionize: tertiary, secondary, allylic, benzylic, never primary, methyl or vinyl). mech-rearrangement (4 worked, 10 practice; kinds written and mech: hydride shifts, methyl shifts and ring expansions of a cation next to a strained ring, including the 11/10 homework, (1-bromoethyl)cyclobutane in ethanol, with its SN1 and E1 products with and without rearrangement, and variations on the past exam's Question 9). mech-organometallic (3 worked, 10 practice; kinds written, mech and mcq: Grignard and organolithium reagents as R:- with water, D2O, alcohols, terminal alkynes and CO2, how they are made, which atom they attack and why, why acid comes last). organometallic-synthesis (3 worked, 8 practice; kind written: from an alkene or an alkyl halide to R-H or R-D in steps, as in the 11/03 homework, with reagents over each arrow). Mechanisms file: content/mechanisms/cations.json (10 to 14 mechanisms that your items use).

agents.label: types-ethers
agents.task: Types: williamson-why (3 worked, 8 practice; kinds written and mcq: for an unsymmetrical ether, which alkoxide and halide pair works and why the other fails, with SN2 and E2 mechanisms, as in the past exam's Question 5A). route-choice (3 worked, 10 practice; kinds mcq with layout pair and written: two routes to one product, pick the clean one and explain, by substrate class, base strength and solvent, as in Question 6A). mech-intramolecular (3 worked, 8 practice; kinds written and mech: analyze the product first, then draw the steps: halohydrin to epoxide, epoxide opening followed by ring closure as in Question 4B, ring formation by an internal nucleophile, five- and six-membered rings). products-from-formula (3 worked, 8 practice; kinds written and mcq with structure choices: a dihalide with a dinucleophile or two equivalents of a nucleophile, working from the molecular formulas to a ring and an open-chain product as in Question 6B; check every formula with tools/chem.py). Mechanisms file: content/mechanisms/ethers.json (8 to 10 mechanisms that your items use).
